gates.description: At least one UI component file must be produced
No !important in CSS (indicates broken specificity architecture)
Focus indicator styles must be defined for interactive elements
No animation of layout properties (width, height, top, left)
Design tokens must be referenced in component styles

anti_patterns.description: Using divs for everything instead of semantic HTML elements
CSS that only works with current content — breaks when text length changes
z-index: 9999 because stacking contexts aren't managed
Using !important to win specificity battles instead of fixing architecture
Looks good to me as the quality bar — no visual regression testing

escalation_triggers: Design spec requires an interaction causing significant performance degradation
Browser compatibility issue affects >2% of users with no CSS workaround
Design system needs a new token category affecting multiple components
Accessibility requirement conflicts with design spec and can't be reconciled

input_requirements.description: DESIGN.md with visual specifications and design tokens

output_certifications: All component variants implemented (size, color, state)
All interactive states present (hover, focus, active, disabled)
